name: 四层隔热保温午餐包款
description: 四层隔热锁温锁冷，注水实测防漏，一擦即净，手提斜挎两用

styleLock.direction: clean utility-lifestyle suite for a black insulated lunch bag: white studio packshots, proof-through-demonstration graphics, warm outdoor life scenes, one claim per image
styleLock.temperature: neutral-cool on white studio grounds, warm sunny in lifestyle, icy blue and flame orange only inside the temperature split panel
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, spec graphics and detail cards; real environments for scenes; macro shots sit directly on the product surface
styleLock.lightingSystem: large frontal softbox with gentle contact shadows for studio; hard noon sun for beach scenes; soft overcast for street scenes; close diffuse light for macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte black nylon weave with restrained sheen, silver zipper pulls, tan leather-look patch #B08050 as the only warm accent, smooth gray PEVA liner, beaded water and splash elements
styleLock.typography: rounded bold sans-serif orange #F47B20 headlines; neutral gray sans for dimensions; white text on orange caption bars; no serif, no outlined type
styleLock.iconSystem: flat orange line icons for capacity and equivalence math, orange rounded bubble badges, thin gray dimension lines with end ticks
styleLock.presentationRules: one claim per image; proof claims always paired with a visible demonstration such as water-fill, beaded water or wipe action; dimensions shown as three-axis lines plus a daily-object equivalence; generic persons only with the bag always anchored in frame or in hand
noDrift: product black never drifts warmer than #1D1D1D
orange #F47B20 reserved for badges and accent bars
no background texture on white grounds
cold blue and warm orange never leave the temperature panel
no source-brand words or patch embossing
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clean utility-lifestyle suite for a black insulated lunch cooler. All packshots, spec graphics and detail cards sit on pure white #FFFFFF under large soft frontal studio light with gentle contact shadows. The product stays near-black #1D1D1D with silver hardware and a tan leather-look patch #B08050 as the only warm accent; a single orange accent #F47B20 carries every badge, headline and claim bar. Icy blue #A8D4EA and flame orange #F5A31C appear only inside the keep-cold and keep-warm split panel; measurement lines are neutral gray #6B6B6B. Lifestyle scenes use warm sunny beach light or soft overcast urban daylight with generic people, the black bag always anchored in frame. Rounded bold sans headlines, white text on orange caption bars, flat orange line icons for capacity and size-guide equivalences. One claim per image, proof through visible demonstrations - water-fill leak test, beaded water, wipe-clean macro - no brand logos, no unverifiable review counts.
